battle.name: 克里昂米尼戰爭
battle.theater: 阿卡迪亞南部美加洛波利斯
battle.brief: 公元前229年至前222年，斯巴達王克萊俄米尼三世向阿開亞聯盟開戰，圖的是拆散聯盟、孤立美加洛波利斯。前227年他在帳篷隘口敗於馬其頓王安提柯多松的方陣與戰象，前222年再於拉多凱亞平原全軍覆沒。決定勝負的是長矛密集方陣與騎兵衝鋒，卡面亞述長矛正是這類長矛兵器的源流。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏈。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 克里昂米尼戰爭是公元前229年至前222年間希臘本土的一場聯盟對抗，交戰主體是斯巴達一方與阿開亞聯盟一方，馬其頓王國介入其中。斯巴達方面由國王克萊俄米尼三世掌兵，他先後拉攏伊利斯、科林斯與玻俄提亞的流亡反對派；斯巴達城邦本身出動的公民重步兵，經過「震懾者」事件後人數大減，實際戰鬥多賴克里特弓手、伊利里亞輕盾兵與科林斯「百人隊」等外來傭兵。聯盟方面以阿卡底亞諸城為骨幹，聯盟將領阿拉圖斯（西基昂人）以治國手腕維繫全局，並拉攏玻俄提亞聯盟、埃托利亞聯盟與美加洛波利斯，兵力以城邦民兵重步兵、騎兵及各城分遣的傭兵組成。馬其頓王安提柯三世（多松）於前227年率步兵、騎兵與戰象越過科林斯地峽介入，成為聯盟實際的軍事支柱。埃及托勒密王朝雖遠在地中海東岸，卻收容並接濟斯巴達流亡者，使戰局始終牽涉外來勢力。
countriesEn: The Cleomenean War was a confrontation inside Greece proper between a Spartan coalition and the Achaean League, fought from 229 to 222 BC, with the kingdom of Macedon in between and finally decisive. On the Spartan side stood King Cleomenes III, who drew in Elis, Corinth and the exiled opposition groups of Boeotia; because the Spartan citizen levy had been thinned by the so-called Tremblers, the actual fighting was done largely by mercenaries such as Cretan archers, Illyrian peltasts and the Hundred of Corinth. On the League side the backbone was the Achaean and Arcadian cities, with the League held together by the diplomacy of the strategos Aratus of Sicyon; the League could call on the Boeotian and Aetolian confederacies and on Megalopolis, and fielded citizen heavy infantry, cavalry and detachments of mercenary auxiliaries. King Antigonus III Doson of Macedon crossed the Isthmus of Corinth in 227 BC with foot, horse and war elephants, and became the military prop of the League. Far away on the eastern Mediterranean, the Ptolemaic kingdom of Egypt gave asylum and money to the Spartan exile, so that the war always dragged in outside powers as well.
people: 斯巴達國王克萊俄米尼三世是全場主導者：前227年他迫使五長老會退位、逼迫王室兄弟讓出王位，並企圖吞下美加洛波利斯；前226年在玻俄提亞的哈利亞爾圖斯遭伏擊，前222年在拉多凱亞平原慘敗後流亡埃及，最終於前219年在亞歷山大絕望自盡。與他對抗的聯盟將領阿拉圖斯長於策劃與交涉，前223年得以把阿爾戈斯拉入聯盟，但戰場指揮長期依賴馬其頓。馬其頓王安提柯多松於前227年帶著馬其頓方陣、少量騎兵與四頭戰象馳援，在帳篷隘口用戰象驚散聯盟騎兵，前222年再於拉多凱亞以密集方陣擊潰斯巴達軍，戰後接掌聯盟最高權力。阿基阿德王朝國王阿雷烏斯拒絕向克萊俄米尼退位，與五長老會構成反對派核心。梅加洛波利斯人斐洛波伊門當時仍是年輕軍人，日後卻成為以步兵戰術主導聯盟的代表人物。埃及方面則是托勒密三世提供金錢與棲身之所。
peopleEn: King Cleomenes III of Sparta drove the course of the whole war. In 227 BC he forced the board of five ephors to abdicate, pushed his royal brother off the throne and tried to take Megalopolis; he was ambushed at Haliartus in Boeotia in 226 BC, was crushed on the plain of Ladoceia in 222 BC, fled to Egypt, and finally killed himself in Alexandria in 219 BC in despair. Against him stood Aratus, whose strength lay in planning and negotiation rather than command: he brought Argos into the League in 223 BC, but for battlefield decisions the League relied on Macedon. Antigonus Doson came to the rescue in 227 BC with the Macedonian phalanx, a small body of horse and four war elephants, used the elephants at the Pass of the Shelters to panic the League cavalry, and in 222 BC broke the Spartan army at Ladoceia with a close-packed pike phalanx before taking the leading position in the League. Areus, king of the Agiad house, refused to abdicate to Cleomenes and formed with the ephors the core of the opposition inside Sparta. Philopoemen of Megalopolis was still a young soldier in these years, but would later become the figurehead of League infantry warfare. On the Egyptian side, Ptolemy III supplied the money and the refuge.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛本身不可能出現在克里昂米尼戰爭的戰場：它是公元前九世紀兩河流域的短柄長刃鐵矛，矛頭裝在鐵套筒內。它在這張卡裡的位置，是「長矛」這一族兵器的源流標本——希臘世界自愛琴海到馬其頓一路承傳的長柄刺擊兵器，源頭都可以追溯到這類近東短柄鐵矛。到戰爭年代，希臘重步兵用的是多利矛（δόρυ）：白蠟木柄長逾兩米，鑲鐵葉形矛頭，尾端裝青銅尾錐，以便插地支撐盾牌；馬其頓方陣用的是薩里沙（σάρισσα），長可四五米，柄部大部分用鐵，靠方陣縱深頂住對方的矛尖。戰役決定性的接觸，仍然是矛牆對撞：斯巴達與聯盟的重步兵都靠列陣後齊刺與推進。所以雖然亞述長矛不在場，它作為「以矛定陣」這一傳統的最早樣本，正對應這場戰爭裡真正左右勝負的兵器結構。場上其他裝備包括重步兵的圓盾（aspis，青銅包邊）、短劍（xiphos）、色雷斯式單刃彎刀（kopis）、輕盾兵的雙投槍與新月盾、克里特弓手的複合弓、騎兵的長槍（kontos）、馬其頓重步兵的伊利里亞式頭盔與脛甲，以及安提柯帶來的四頭戰象。攻城方面，聯盟於前223年圍攻科林斯，以撞槌與雲梯對付城牆；封鎖方面則靠控制科林斯地峽。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card cannot have been present on any battlefield of the Cleomenean War: it is a short-shafted, long-bladed iron spear of the ninth century BC from the Mesopotamian river valleys, its head socketed in iron. Its place on this card is that of a type specimen of the spear family, for the long thrusting weapons the Greek world inherited from the Aegean through Macedonia all trace back to this Near Eastern short-hafted iron spear. By the time of the war the Greek heavy infantry carried the dory, an ash shaft over two metres long with an iron leaf-shaped blade and a bronze butt spike so that it could be planted to support the shield, while the Macedonian phalanx used the sarissa, four to five metres long with a shaft largely of iron, held in a deep order that bore down on the enemy's points. The decisive contact of battle remained a collision of spear walls, both the Spartans and the League closing up and pushing with levelled points. So although the Assyrian spear was not on the field, it stands as the earliest sample of the tradition in which the array is decided by the spear, and that is exactly the structure that decided this war. Other equipment on the field included the round aspis shield with a bronze rim, the short xiphos sword, the single-edged Thracian kopis, the two javelins and crescent pelta of the peltasts, the composite bows of the Cretan archers, the kontos cavalry lance, the Illyrian-type helmets and greaves of the Macedonian heavy infantry, and the four war elephants Antigonus brought with him. On the siege side, the League battered Corinth in 223 BC with rams and ladders, while the blockade worked through control of the Isthmus of Corinth.
tactics: 斯巴達一方的戰術核心是守險與襲擾。克萊俄米尼不與對方爭奪開闊地帶，而是憑藉帳篷隘口、科林斯地峽等關隘切割敵軍，再用騎兵奇襲與夜襲消耗聯盟。他曾縱兵掠奪伊利斯與阿卡底亞的田莊，試圖以破壞收成逼聯盟飢餓；每到戰役季節便集中兵力打一次會戰，打完即退回斯巴達本土。聯盟與馬其頓一方的戰術完全相反，靠方陣厚度與騎兵迂迴取勝：安提柯把四頭戰象放在陣前，利用象群對馬匹的驚嚇衝散聯盟騎兵，使斯巴達得以一度突進；但同一批象兵也被聯盟步兵以縱深列陣頂住。前222年拉多凱亞之戰，聯盟方把馬其頓式密集長矛方陣擺在正面，以縱深與投射量硬吃斯巴達較輕的方陣，騎兵同時負責包抄與追擊殘部，斯巴達軍一旦被正面頂住便無法重整。圍城戰術是戰爭的另一條主線：聯盟封住科林斯與阿爾戈斯的陸路與海路，堵塞糧道，再以撞槌與投石機攻城。兩軍補給都靠隨軍糧車、城邦徵發與沿海運糧，雨季與酷暑令多數會戰只能壓在夏季作戰季節。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the Spartan side was the holding of defiles and harassment. Cleomenes did not fight for open ground; he used the Pass of the Shelters and the Isthmus of Corinth to cut the enemy apart, striking with cavalry and night attacks to wear the League down. He stripped the fields of Elis and Arcadia, hoping to starve the League by ruining its harvest, and concentrated his force for one set-piece battle each campaigning season before falling back into Spartan territory. The League and Macedon were the exact opposite, winning with the depth of the phalanx and with cavalry working round the flank: Antigonus put four elephants in front of his line and used their effect on the horses to panic the League cavalry, giving Cleomenes a moment to charge, but the same elephants were then held off by the League infantry in a deep order. At Ladoceia in 222 BC the League put a Macedonian-style deep pike phalanx on the front, using depth and weight of javelins to eat up the lighter Spartan phalanx, while the cavalry enveloped and pursued the broken; once pinned head on, the Spartan army could not re-form. Siege was the other main line of the war: the League sealed the land and sea approaches of Corinth and Argos, cut the supply routes, and worked the walls with rams and stone-throwers. Supply for both sides came from baggage trains, city levies and coastal shipping, and the rainy season and summer heat compressed most set-piece battles into the summer campaigning window.
data: 關於時間：戰爭一般定在公元前229年至前222年，歷時約七年，主要會戰有前227年帳篷隘口、前226年哈利亞爾圖斯、前224年萊卡翁山與涅瑪河一帶、前222年拉多凱亞四次。關於開戰月份，古代文獻只把戰爭定位在希臘曆的戰役季節，即雨季過後、收穫之前，沒有明確日期，本卡按夏初六月登錄。兵力方面：安提柯前227年投入的馬其頓部隊，記載為步兵四千、騎兵五百，另有戰象四頭；聯盟騎兵以千計；克萊俄米尼前226年襲入玻俄提亞時，帶著約三千步兵、數百騎兵。損失方面：帳篷隘口之戰，古代記載聯軍一方傷亡以數千計、被俘數百，斯巴達方面的損失遠小於此；克萊俄米尼負傷退回美加洛波利斯時，只剩約三百人隨行。拉多凱亞之戰的傷亡，古代記載兩軍合計約兩千上下，斯巴達一方略重。以上數字出自古代記述，彼此常有出入，只宜當作量級參考。距離方面，主要戰場美加洛波利斯周邊多在一至三日的行軍範圍之內，斯巴達本部至阿卡底亞戰場約需兩三日推進。
dataEn: On timing, the war is normally dated from 229 to 222 BC, about seven years, with the main set-piece actions at the Pass of the Shelters in 227 BC, Haliartus in 226 BC, the hills around Mount Lycaeum and the river Nemea in 224 BC, and Ladoceia in 222 BC. On the opening month, the ancient texts only place the outbreak within the Greek campaigning season, after the rains and before the harvest, with no exact date, so this card records an early summer month, June. On strength, the Macedonian force Antigonus brought in 227 BC is recorded as four thousand foot, five hundred horse and four elephants; the League cavalry numbered in the thousands; Cleomenes took about three thousand foot and several hundred horse into Boeotia in 226 BC. On losses, the ancient account of the Pass of the Shelters gives the League side casualties in the thousands with several hundred prisoners, the Spartan loss being far smaller, and Cleomenes, wounded and withdrawing to Megalopolis, had about three hundred men with him. The casualties of Ladoceia are given as roughly two thousand in all, a little heavier on the Spartan side. These figures come from ancient narrative, disagree in places, and are useful only as orders of magnitude. On distances, the main theatre around Megalopolis lay within one to three days' march, and pushing from Sparta into Arcadia took two or three days.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最外層是地緣：斯巴達自伯羅奔尼撒戰爭之後一直是希臘南部霸主，但阿開亞聯盟自前280年代末重建以來，靠聯盟體制吸納阿卡底亞、美加洛波利斯與阿爾戈斯等城，實力逐年上升；美加洛波利斯更是前371年由城民集資建立、帶頭脫離斯巴達的反斯巴達堡壘，聯盟一旦壯大，斯巴達就再難獨佔伯羅奔尼撒。直接導火線是前229年：聯盟正忙於應付伊斯特拉戰事與馬其頓在伊利里亞方向的牽制，克萊俄米尼乘機奪取拉西翁、馬基奈與克勒俄奈等要塞，一夜之間把大半個阿卡底亞握在手中；前227年他再以伊利斯為同盟攻入美加洛波利斯，並拉攏玻俄提亞與科林斯的流亡派。內在原因則是斯巴達內部的權力危機：克萊俄米尼於前227年迫五長老會退位、迫王室兄弟讓位，把斯巴達變成個人統治，又急著用對外勝利沖淡合法性問題。阿基阿德國王阿雷烏斯拒絕退位，衝突於是從聯盟對抗升級成斯巴達內部分裂加對外開戰。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause. The outermost was geography: since the Peloponnesian War Sparta had been the dominant power in southern Greece, but the Achaean League, rebuilt from the late 280s BC, had drawn in Arcadia, Megalopolis and Argos under a federal constitution and grown steadily stronger. Megalopolis in particular had been founded in 371 BC by the pooled savings of its citizens as a city that had broken away from Sparta, and a strong League made a restored Spartan hegemony impossible. The immediate trigger came in 229 BC: while the League was occupied with the Istrian war and with the Macedonian distraction in Illyria, Cleomenes seized Lasion, Makyneia and Cleonae, and in a single stroke took control of most of Arcadia; in 227 BC he marched on Megalopolis with Elis as an ally and pulled in the exiled parties of Boeotia and Corinth. The innermost cause was the crisis inside Sparta. In 227 BC Cleomenes forced the ephors to abdicate and pushed his royal brother off the throne, turning the city into a personal monarchy, and he needed a victory outside to cover that breach of legitimacy. Areus of the Agiad house refused to abdicate, and the conflict therefore escalated from a league war into a civil war inside Sparta fought alongside a war outside.
impact: 戰爭最深的影響，是把希臘世界的權力重心由斯巴達移到馬其頓。前222年之後，阿開亞聯盟吸納斯巴達、阿爾戈斯與科林斯，伯羅奔尼撒再沒有一個獨立的斯巴達中心；安提柯多松隨即以「領袖」身份入主聯盟，地峽防線、盟軍駐防與聯盟的決策權都落在馬其頓手裡。這個格局直接通往其後的社會戰爭（前220至前217年）、馬其頓對希臘的全面干預，最終把整個希臘世界推上腓力五世與羅馬衝突的前夜。另一層影響涉及聯盟自身的制度：打敗的斯巴達可以入盟、被降格為成員城之一，其公民兵與外來傭兵混編的舊戰力被拆散，聯盟則開始發展以步兵方陣為核心、以職業化傭兵為補充的新軍制，斐洛波伊門日後的改革正是這條線的延伸。對埃及托勒密王朝而言，收留斯巴達流亡國王是低成本的外交籌碼，但同時也提醒安提柯：科林斯地峽是亞歷山大世界與埃及競爭的關鍵點。
impactEn: The deepest effect of the war was to move the centre of gravity of the Greek world from Sparta to Macedon. After 222 BC the Achaean League took in Sparta, Argos and Corinth, and the Peloponnese no longer had an independent Spartan centre; Antigonus Doson entered the League as its leader, and the fortified line across the Isthmus, the League garrisons and the League's decision-making all came into Macedonian hands. That settlement led directly to the Social War of 220-217 BC and to Macedonian intervention across Greece, and it pushed the whole Greek world towards the confrontation between Philip V and Rome that followed. A second effect concerned the League's own institutions: a beaten Sparta could be admitted as a member and reduced to one city among many, its old citizen-and-mercenary mix broken up, and the League began to develop an army built on the infantry phalanx and supplemented by professional mercenary troops; Philopoemen's later reform is the continuation of that line. For the Ptolemaic kingdom, taking in a Spartan exile king was a cheap diplomatic card, but it also reminded Antigonus that the Isthmus of Corinth was the hinge on which the world of Alexandria and the rival claims of Egypt turned.
result: 前222年拉多凱亞平原一戰，聯盟與馬其頓聯軍以密集長矛方陣正面壓垮斯巴達軍，騎兵隨即封住退路，斯巴達軍被大量殲滅與俘獲。克萊俄米尼帶著殘部逃回美加洛波利斯一帶，隨後放棄阿卡底亞、經科林斯地峽退入伯羅奔尼撒，最後由埃及托勒密三世收留。他在埃及招兵買馬，組成的外國傭兵軍規模遠不足以翻盤；前219年在亞歷山大城得知聯盟軍進逼的消息後，絕望自盡。斯巴達隨即被迫加入阿開亞聯盟，五長老會與王權重新整頓，阿基阿德王朝的國王回國；阿爾戈斯與科林斯亦相繼入盟。安提柯多松成為聯盟的實際領袖，翌年（前221年）遠征伊利里亞時去世，由其子腓力五世繼承，成為下一階段希臘霸權的支點。克里昂米尼戰爭以斯巴達霸權告終，以聯盟與馬其頓聯手告終，也以「長矛方陣」壓過「騎兵與關隘戰術」告終。
resultEn: At the plain of Ladoceia in 222 BC the League-Macedonian army broke the Spartan force head on with a deep pike phalanx, the cavalry closed the exits, and the Spartan army was largely destroyed or captured. Cleomenes got back with the remnants to the neighbourhood of Megalopolis, then gave up Arcadia, withdrew through the Isthmus into the Peloponnese, and was finally taken in by Ptolemy III of Egypt. In Egypt he raised mercenaries, but the force he assembled was far too small to turn the war, and in 219 BC, on hearing that the League's army was closing in, he killed himself in despair in Alexandria. Sparta was then compelled to join the Achaean League, the ephorate and kingship were reorganised, the Agiad king returned home, and Argos and Corinth entered the League in turn. Antigonus Doson became the effective leader of the League and died the following year, in 221 BC, on an Illyrian expedition; his son Philip V succeeded him and became the pivot of the next phase of Greek hegemony. The Cleomenean War ended Spartan hegemony, ended with the League and Macedon acting together, and ended with the pike phalanx prevailing over cavalry and defile warfare.
